answer: A single thread of reputation then links every new agent to an existing member through a vetted bridge agent who stakes collateral equal to the newcomer's bond. Each agent must post a bond that doubles per reputation slot and lock it as an anchor tied to one verified wallet. Faking a sybil cluster thus costs the attacker the full bond of each identity plus the bridge's slashed stake, making large-scale infiltration economically irrational. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
